name: minh-skills
description: Minh Duong's personal Claude Code marketplace — skills he built and uses himself.

plugins.name: minh-toolkit
plugins.description: Minh's personal skill collection: coaching-style skills for learning, writing, branding, and code, plus a YouTube video critic. Each skill's own SKILL.md documents its purpose in detail.

plugins.name: template-plugin
plugins.description: Not a real toolkit — a minimal, working example plugin kept in this marketplace to show the folder shape a new plugin needs (its own plugin.json plus a skills/ directory). Copy plugins/template-plugin/ as the starting point for a new plugin.
